notes: Same random seed as original estimators is retained from base config; v11 seed only samples extra XGB candidates.
No early stopping; fixed tree counts ensure extra validation data is not reused for stopping.
Each candidate fits once per past-year fold; 1:1,2:1,3:1 reuse predictions but independently select params.
Full-event outcomes stay grouped and all preprocessing uses earlier years only.

d1_limitations.reason: Historical OD publication/available_at timestamps are unverified; chronological observation dates alone do not prove D-1 availability.
d1_limitations.calendar_note: Existing selected-date audit uses a retrospective government calendar; historical calendar vintages are not verified.
d1_limitations.target_definition: Origin trips in source hourly bins; not verified platform arrivals or physical passenger trajectories.
d1_limitations.optional_activity_snapshot: loaded for EDA only; actual outcomes are excluded from MODEL_FEATURES

planned_show_end_summary.limitation: Announcement-version fields are audited; no archived historical website version. Planned end is not observed egress or station arrival.
